get.description:
Describe Vision Gateway stream surfaces.

ROS/rosbridge remains the production browser stream plane. The local MJPEG
endpoint is a debug/fallback helper for Lane B synthetic validation.

schema.title: Response Vision Streams Api V1 Vision Streams Get

get.description:
Return the read-only ROS2 topic handoff matrix for Lane B/C planning.

This endpoint does not start ROS2, does not publish overlays, and does not
expose motion control. It exists so GUI/Main/ROS developers can align on the
source-to-topic contract before Lane C ROS ingest/domain bridge work.

200.description: Lane B ROS2/domain-bridge handoff topic matrix

schema.title: Response Vision Ros Topics Api V1 Vision Ros Topics Get

get.description: Return what the next worker tick would do without processing frames.

200.description: Lane B read-only worker readiness snapshot

schema.title: Response Vision Worker Status Api V1 Vision Worker Status Get

post.description:
Run one controlled latest-frame processing tick for Lane B validation.

This is a robot-free debug/control surface for the future evidence worker.
It processes only explicit configured sources and never publishes ROS motion
commands. Production browser video remains rosbridge 9090.

schema.title: Response Vision Worker Tick Api V1 Vision Worker Tick Post

get.description: Return one-shot source/frame/overlay readiness snapshots for Lane B debug use.

schema.title: Response Vision Debug Sources Api V1 Vision Debug Sources Get

post.description:
Store one raw frame in the latest-frame cache without detection.

This is a Lane B robot-free seam for future ROS2/camera ingest. It lets
callers push a frame, inspect it with `/vision/frame/latest`, and then run
`/vision/worker/tick` to process it. It is not the production browser stream
plane and it does not publish ROS motion commands.

schema.title: Response Ingest Frame Api V1 Vision Frame Post

post.description:
Store one raw frame and immediately render AI/detection overlay.

This ROS-free endpoint is optimized for the D1 gateway hot path: one HTTP
request updates the latest-frame cache and overlay cache, avoiding the older
frame POST -> worker tick race. It still publishes no ROS/control topics.

200.description: Latest-frame ingest plus immediate overlay processing response

schema.title: Response Ingest And Process Frame Api V1 Vision Frame Process Post

get.description:
Return latest raw frame metadata for one source.

This is a Lane B debug/fallback endpoint for visual QA. It exposes only the
newest cached frame and does not queue historical frames.

schema.title: Response Latest Frame Api V1 Vision Frame Latest Get

get.description:
Return latest raw frame image for one source.

This is a debug/fallback image endpoint for comparing raw frame evidence
against rendered overlays. Production browser streaming remains rosbridge.
Return latest visual evidence overlay metadata for one source.

schema.title: Response Latest Overlay Api V1 Vision Overlay Latest Get

get.description: Return latest overlay image for one source as JPEG.

Debug/fallback MJPEG stream of latest overlays.

This is not the production browser stream plane; rosbridge 9090 remains the
default production path per Lane 0.

schema.title: Response Metrics Snapshot Api V1 Metrics Get

post.description:
Generate and ingest a synthetic ArUco frame for robot-free Lane B validation.

This debug endpoint exercises the same latest-frame, detection, and overlay
path used by uploaded images, without requiring a physical camera or ROS2.

200.description: Synthetic frame detection response with overlay metadata

marker_id.description: Decoded marker ID. Required by policy before WMS confirms item/slot identity.

pose_estimate.description: Optional 2D/tag-pose estimate only. No depth camera is required in MVP1.

depth_median_m.description: Reserved for future depth-camera variants. Must remain null in MVP1.

wms_hint.description: Non-authoritative hint. WMS-lite decides final task/slot/exception state.

items.title: SmartFactory VisionEvent v1
items.description: API-first contract for AI Server evidence events sent to Main Server/WMS-lite. AI Server emits evidence only; WMS-lite owns final state transitions.

schema.title: Response Ingest Synthetic Frame Api V1 Vision Synthetic Frame Post

post.description:
Evaluate caller-supplied detector/segmenter candidates against an ROI.

This is the MVP seam between future model providers and the stable
LiftRoiEvidence contract. It intentionally accepts synthetic/provided
candidates instead of selecting a concrete runtime model.

schema.title: SmartFactory LiftRoiEvidence v1
schema.description: AI Server evidence payload for lift ROI load counting and pickup/dropoff verification. This is separate from VisionEvent v1; WMS/Main owns final task and inventory state transitions.

post.description: Evaluate lift ROI evidence from an uploaded image using the configured segmenter.
